newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore August CPI rises 1.4 percent on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore August CPI rises 1.4 percent on year.

text.p: Singapore's August consumer price index (CPI) was up 1.4 percent from a year earlier and up 0.1 percent over July, the Department of Statistics said on Monday.
In July, the CPI was up 1.3 percent from a year earlier and unchanged from June.
A Reuter poll of economists last week predicted the CPI would rise 1.5 percent year-on-year in August.

Note - In August year-on-year food rose by 2.1 percent, clothing rose by 0.7, housing rose by 0.3, transportation and communication rose by 0.5, education rose by 3.0, health rose by 2.0 and miscellaneous rose by 2.3.
